## About
Selecta Auto Body is a small family business in Bernal Heights. Our owner, J.R. Hubbard, is the son of one of the original owners, and his cousin Anthony Molinas runs the shop floor. We fix cars for neighbors in Noe Valley, Bernal Heights, Glen Park, the Mission District and the rest of SF.
We built our shop from the ground up to be as eco-friendly as we could make it, with a high-efficiency spray booth, water-based paints, LED lighting and a detail department that uses low to no V.O.C. products.
Our goal is reputable, dependable and honest collision repair with customer service as the top priority. We're rated 4.8 from 199 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision repair: If you've been in a wreck, we help you through the repair process and get your car back on the road with less stress.
- Bumpers put back together: Bumpers that got knocked loose, put back together.
- Scratch repainting: Bring in a scratch and we'll repaint it.
- Fenders and doors: Fenders replaced and doors brought back to normal.
- Detailing: Our detail department uses environment-friendly products with low to no V.O.C.

## FAQ
Q: How do I start an estimate?
A: You can begin with our Selecta Photo App, or give us a call and we'll walk you through it.

Q: Can you help with my insurance questions?
A: One reviewer said our team answered all their questions about paint matching and billing insurance. Ask us when you bring your car in.

Q: What kind of paint do you use?
A: We use water-based paints, as the city of San Francisco requires, cured in our air-curing system.
